The Walt Disney Company has announced it will hold its next quarterly earnings call on November 17 at 8:30 AM ET/5:30 AM PT.
 The call will cover the company's fourth-quarter results as well as its full fiscal year for 2026. Disney's fiscal year starts on October 1 rather than running with the calendar year.
 While not specified in the announcement, Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro and Chief Financial Officer Hugh Johnstone will be on hand to lead the call. [...] While dollars and cents will be the core focus of the call, it's not uncommon for Disney to drop news that fans will appreciate alongside the numbers.
 The call will be available for anyone to listen to on the Walt Disney Company website.
